decision: Keep algorithms and admission thresholds unchanged. Run fresh instances, including the observed local-exception failure. Final data will decide qualification; no threshold repair on final outcomes.
measurement_followup: The pilot justifies a separate informative-measurement and adequacy-challenge experiment. It will have its own seeds and frozen protocol.
limits: CPU one thread; 2 GiB committed tree. The 1474.78-second opening balance is a cap, not a target to consume.
